In the case of the constant flow on Euclidean space we have \[ f(\tau )=\tau ^{-n/2}e^{-\tilde l(Z,\tau )}{\mathcal J}(Z,\tau )=2^ne^{-|Z|^2}. \] \end{claim}

This computation has consequences for all Ricci flows.

Proposition
[Limit of the reduced-volume integrand]
